title: Document Ledger Decision Taxonomy
description: Canonical classification labels for the Classification Engine. Version 1.0.

domains.label: Business
domains.description: Decisions about product direction, policy, budget, organizational process, or customer commitments

domains.label: Technical
domains.description: Decisions about system structure, implementation, infrastructure, security architecture, or engineering practice

domains.label: Hybrid
domains.description: Decisions with material business and technical consequences requiring both lenses

categories.label: Architecture
categories.description: Structure, patterns, component boundaries, integration style

categories.label: Infrastructure & DevOps
categories.description: Cloud, deployment, CI/CD, runtime, observability platform choices

categories.label: Security & Compliance
categories.description: Auth, data protection, regulatory controls, audit requirements

categories.label: Data & Storage
categories.description: Database selection, data model, retention, migration

categories.label: Integration & API
categories.description: External interfaces, contracts, event schemas, partner integrations

categories.label: Product & Scope
categories.description: Feature scope, roadmap, prioritization, customer-facing commitments

categories.label: Process & Governance
categories.description: Approval workflows, team process, operating model, documentation standards

categories.label: Financial & Budget
categories.description: Budget allocation, vendor spend, cost trade-offs

categories.label: Vendor & Procurement
categories.description: Tooling/vendor selection with contractual or operational impact

analysis_profiles.label: Full analysis
analysis_profiles.description: Default for technical and hybrid decisions with architectural significance

analysis_profiles.label: Standard analysis
analysis_profiles.description: Business decisions with same sub-engines as full analysis; lighter impact templates

analysis_profiles.label: Lightweight analysis
analysis_profiles.description: Low-risk or operational decisions; skip deep impact analysis

analysis_profiles.label: Review-first
analysis_profiles.description: Low confidence; route directly to Review & Approval Portal with minimal automated analysis
